description: Send a draft for signature. Each recipient gets an email from "<Company> via md2sign" with the document and a unique signing link. Uses one envelope, however many people sign. Needs a confirmed email and a plan (or its free trial); once sent, the document can't be edited. Returns sending_suspended if recipients reported the account's emails as spam, recipient_opted_out for recipients who asked not to be emailed, quota_exceeded when the envelopes on the plan are used up (with top_up_url to buy more), and trial_limit when a free-trial limit is reached.

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

document_id.description: The document ID returned by create_draft, list_documents or create_document_from_template. Must be a draft.

message.description: Optional short note from the sender to include in the email.

name: send_document
title: Send a document for signature
